name: jira-remote-data-fields-forge-app
description: a Jira text-properties UI backed by a Forge Remote

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target browser --format iife --outfile resources/index.js
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run lint
scripts.forge:deploy:approve-system-user-change: bun run build && bash ../../scripts/env-var.sh 'forge deploy --environment "$FORGE_ENVIRONMENT" --approve SYSTEM_USER_CHANGE_RULE'
scripts.lint: bun run lint:biome && bun run typecheck
